name: The five terms the reader needs
shape: A box of at most five terms with a one-line gloss each, taken from the profiles' concept glosses (weight first), placed before the first section that uses them.
didactic: The vocabulary of the argument before the argument.
example: social-property relations · rules for reproduction · market dependence · primitive accumulation · political capitalism.

evidence.note: defining five basic terms before the argument slows a researcher audience that wants density, not orientation
